purpose: Non-admission source discovery of European national building identifiers, footprints, 3D height, EPC/enrichment and cost context for bounded EUBUCCO crosswalk pilots; documentation does not permit source-data acquisition or model-input use.

entries.name: Germany nationwide LoD2-DE 3D buildings
entries.temporal_scope: Annual snapshots; April 2026 product documented
entries.resolution_or_granularity: About 59 million official building models; unique object ID, footprint reference, height, function, roof, optional storeys/address
entries.note: Nationwide full product is offered commercially, not a general free bulk feed. Join EUBUCCO by reviewed footprint spatial matching; do not infer construction year from production date. Official object IDs may link LoD2 to 2D footprints. Separate per-state open data may offer a cheaper pilot.

entries.name: Bavaria open LoD2 3D buildings
entries.provider: Bayerisches Landesamt für Digitalisierung, Breitband und Vermessung
entries.temporal_scope: Regularly updated state open-data publication; pin selected download revision
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official CityGML LoD2 building geometry with modelled roof shape; details and attributes require tile-specific checks
entries.note: Prioritise one Bavarian pilot tile. Record licence/attribution, tile identity, CRS, building model identifiers, year and source; compare polygon geometry and height against EUBUCCO. State data does not establish insured value or verified occupancy.

entries.name: Netherlands Basic Register of Addresses and Buildings (BAG)
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously maintained administrative register; service refreshed regularly
entries.resolution_or_granularity: BAG building objects (panden), addresses and associated administrative attributes; stable register IDs with lifecycle/status
entries.note: Use BAG pand identifiers for internal linkage to 3DBAG, and match EUBUCCO geometries spatially with version/time checks. Demolished/historical status must not be treated as current active buildings. Avoid publishing address-level personal linkage.

entries.name: Netherlands 3DBAG building models
entries.temporal_scope: Versioned derived 3D releases; source snapshots must be pinned
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Building-level LoD 3D geometry, elevations/heights and connections to BAG identifiers
entries.note: Strong BAG-ID connection to ground building geometry. 3DBAG is a derived geometry/model product; preserve point-cloud/source, release and modelling uncertainty before adopting derived heights. Suitable holdout for EUBUCCO.

entries.name: France Référentiel National des Bâtiments (RNB)
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained registry; published national and departmental extracts plus API
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Building identities with public RNB identifiers, footprints/location and administrative change history
entries.note: RNB-ID is the canonical join candidate with IGN BD TOPO and some ADEME DPE observations; record match multiplicity, building status, source timestamp and any split/merge. A public identity is not a verified insurance location.

entries.name: France IGN BD TOPO buildings and RNB crosswalk
entries.provider: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière (IGN)
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained BD TOPO releases, including 2026 documented mapping
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Building polygons and a documented association between RNB identifiers and BD TOPO building identifiers
entries.note: Prefer the publisher RNB-to-BD-TOPO relation rather than an assumed universal one-to-one join. Preserve release, topology, exceptions and overlapping/multiple objects when matching EUBUCCO. Do not use mapping as identity proof without geometry checks.

entries.name: France Base de Données Nationale des Bâtiments (BDNB)
entries.temporal_scope: Versioned public BDNB files including 2026-02.b published dataset
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Building-level data and derived attributes from public sources, including energy and construction context; varying source confidence
entries.note: Potential enrichment through BDNB building IDs and mapped RNB records after verifying field-level lineage. Many columns are inferred; a same-coordinate match is not enough to assert exact year/material. Check privacy and reuse conditions per release.

entries.name: France ADEME building energy performance diagnostics (DPE)
entries.spatial_scope: France, with coverage limited to properties having certificates
entries.temporal_scope: Ongoing certificate issuance and public-data revisions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Energy performance certificate records, some tied to RNB building IDs and address context
entries.note: RNB-linked certificates allow controlled enrichment, but a dwelling/EPC is not always one full building. Distinguish unit from building, multiple certificates per property, source date, uncertain geocodes and private-address handling; not a universal complete stock inventory.

entries.name: Poland BDOT10k national topographic object database
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained official topographic object coverage; freeze selected release
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Vector topographic objects including 2D buildings and selected descriptive building information at 1:10,000 class
entries.note: Reference candidate for Polish EUBUCCO geometry coverage. BDOT10k footprint keys and object revisions must be retained, and scale/completeness assessed; building counts alone do not show insured exposure.

entries.name: Poland official 3D building models based on BDOT10k
entries.spatial_scope: Poland, substantial but not necessarily complete national coverage
entries.temporal_scope: Official model releases; regional availability varies
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 3D building geometry compiled from BDOT10k footprints and elevation inputs
entries.note: Link to the underlying BDOT10k footprint after validating object IDs, snapshot and geometry relationships. Derivative height/roof information is not independent cadastral evidence or replacement value.

entries.name: Czechia RÚIAN building and address register
entries.provider: ČÚZK (Czech Office for Surveying, Mapping and Cadastre)
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously maintained reference register with periodic VFR public extracts
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official building objects, registered identifiers, addresses and selected spatial relationships
entries.note: High-priority primary-source Czech building benchmark. Preserve RÚIAN building IDs and update timestamp and validate whether extracted geometry is building polygon or representative point. Do not conflate parcel, address and building identities.

entries.name: Spain Dirección General del Catastro INSPIRE Buildings
entries.provider: Dirección General del Catastro / Ministerio de Hacienda
entries.spatial_scope: Spain excluding Basque Country and Navarra in this service
entries.temporal_scope: Municipality-level published ATOM files and WFS service; update frequency by service
entries.resolution_or_granularity: INSPIRE building geometries and cadastre-linked identifiers, with service-specific attribute scope
entries.note: Building footprint validation and possible cadastral-attribute joins require exact atom snapshot, municipality, identifiers and geometry structure. Catalan and other regional cases require source-specific checks; do not claim full Spain coverage from the central service.

entries.name: Switzerland swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 Beta
entries.spatial_scope: Switzerland; official EGID integration available in a growing subset of cantons
entries.temporal_scope: Rolling beta releases; June 2026 release documented
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 3D building roofs, facades and footprints, with federal building identifiers (EGID) in supported regions
entries.note: Where EGID is present, connect to Swiss official building/address registers; where absent, use spatial geometry with explicit uncertainty. Distinguish beta geographic coverage from all-Switzerland visualization and do not project EGID completeness to all cantons.

entries.name: Denmark Building and Dwelling Register (BBR)
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained administrative building and dwelling records; modern GraphQL service
entries.resolution_or_granularity: BBR building, unit, floors, usage and construction attributes associated with Danish register identifiers
entries.note: Exact BBR identifier and address/building linkage requires the source schema. Prefer GraphQL/file download; historical REST is being retired. Verify authentication, field visibility, location precision, status and redistribution before any use.

entries.name: Finland National Land Survey INSPIRE Buildings polygons
entries.spatial_scope: Finland, coverage according to NLS official INSPIRE building dataset
entries.temporal_scope: National topographic/inspire revisions; separate 3D sample areas
entries.resolution_or_granularity: INSPIRE-compatible building polygon features via official download services
entries.note: Compare exact polygon definitions and region coverage with EUBUCCO. Finnish 3D buildings are not currently all-country complete; preserve model versus surveyed sources and validate CRS/IDs before automated joining.

entries.name: Norway FKB-Bygning building geometries
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously updated FKB source; delivery/access depend on user class
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official FKB building geometry with source/topographic characteristics distributed through Geonorge formats and APIs
entries.note: Access can be conditional or paid depending on user; catalogue visibility is not permission to bulk download. Evaluate building object IDs and survey vintages only after obtaining an authorised asset and rights decision.

entries.name: Sweden Lantmäteriet Building Download / INSPIRE
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained Swedish building/register data; access via national provider distribution
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official building products include Building Direct and municipal INSPIRE downloads with some purposes/use classes
entries.note: Do not equate Lantmäteriet discoverability with a no-cost full commercial data grant. Confirm which geometry fields and persistent ids are available at exact municipal release; compare to EUBUCCO with source and temporal alignment.

entries.name: England and Wales official Energy Performance Certificates bulk data
entries.provider: UK Department for Levelling Up / GOV.UK
entries.spatial_scope: England and Wales, certified buildings only
entries.temporal_scope: Rolling EPC data releases, multiple certificate vintages
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Domestic/non-domestic energy certificates with construction and energy attributes for covered properties
entries.note: Not a comprehensive building inventory or authoritative footprint layer. Linking to building geometry requires carefully validated UPRN/address mapping, one-to-many EPC relationships and permitted data use; no identity-based release without privacy review.

entries.name: Eurostat construction costs of new residential buildings
entries.temporal_scope: Time-series construction cost/producer price indicators; revisions possible
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Country- and period-specific index values for residential construction cost developments
entries.note: Use only to index externally validated replacement cost benchmarks to a specific price year. An index is NOT an absolute cost per square metre, building-level replacement value or insurance sum. Distinguish materials, labor and producer price definitions and country coverage.

entries.name: crossCERT open database for energy performance certificate testing
entries.spatial_scope: Selected European and UK study countries; project sample not comprehensive
entries.temporal_scope: Research project dataset, version and covered sample dates to be reviewed
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Selected buildings with comparable EPC-related variables used for cross-country methodology tests
entries.note: Potential independent benchmarking of attribute semantics and imputation, not a complete building inventory. Preserve participating countries, observational selection bias, privacy/licence constraints and no invented building-level matches when no stable identifier exists.
